provenance.origin: documentation and independent source inspection; not a live AWS, Ceph or MinIO capture

references.use: Single-range GET and signed response overrides; conditional evaluation precedes body selection.
HEAD has no body; satisfiable range changes length, unsatisfiable range is 416. Local wire fixture uses the documented successful 200 status.

test_ranged_request_response_code, test_ranged_request_skip_leading_bytes_response_code, test_ranged_request_return_trailing_bytes_response_code and invalid-range cases: input testcontent, 4-7, 4-, -7, 40-50; expected bytes, Content-Range and GET status.

Independent source omits stored checksums for ranged GET and HEAD; all six response override fields. Its ranged HEAD status is 206, unlike the successful 200 description in AWS HeadObject documentation; local comparator differences are not AWS facts.

local_rules.syntax: One strict bytes= range; checked u64 endpoints; no whitespace, signs, multiple ranges, reversal or overflow. InvalidArgument for malformed syntax.
local_rules.selection: Authorize and evaluate conditions first; clip the end or suffix to full length; zero suffix and every range on an empty object return InvalidRange.
local_rules.projection: GET 206 and body; HEAD 200 with selected length and Content-Range, no body. Whole-object checksums/type omitted whenever Range is supplied, including a range covering all bytes.
local_rules.overrides: Validate all six using shared representation rules, preserve present empty strings, reject anonymous overrides even for public objects, change detached response only. HTTP dates use whole-second wire precision.

limitations: Exact HEAD status, header presence and empty suffix behavior have not been compared against live AWS.
These vectors cover ranges and response overrides, not completed-part selection or combined Range/partNumber requests.
